quote: On January 31, 2019, Super Micro Computer, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company"), entered into that certain First Amendment to Loan and Security Agreement (the "Amendment") by and among the Company, the financial institutions party to that certain Loan and Security Agreement, dated April 19, 2018 (as amended, restated, amended or restated, extended, supplemented, or otherwise modified from time to time, the "Loan Agreement") as Lenders, and Bank of America, N.A., a national banking association, as administrative agent for the Lenders, amending the Loan Agreement.
